v_trigger = {
	exists = $TARGET$
}
v_rich_trigger = {
	OR = {
		gold > big_value
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { is_adult = yes }
			v_inline_trigger = yes
		}
	}
	big_value > 3
	any_rich_vassal = { is_adult = yes }
}
v_rule_trigger = {
	NOT = { any_child = { v_rich_trigger = yes } }
	has_game_rule = opt_b
	has_game_rule = opt_hard
	has_game_rule = opt_fast
	has_game_rule = opt_a
}
